description: This Java class 'SettingsActivity' extends PreferenceActivity and manages user preferences for network usage settings in an Android application. It loads preferences from an XML resource, registers and unregisters preference change listeners, and updates a static flag to refresh the display when preferences change.

classes.name: SettingsActivity
classes.description: Activity managing network usage preference settings, with lifecycle methods for preference change handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the preferences UI by loading preference XML.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers shared preference change listener when activity resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters shared preference change listener when activity pauses.

methods.name: onSharedPreferenceChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when shared preferences change; sets a static flag to refresh display.
